condition.narrative: The Borrower, through the Working Group, shall prepare and furnish to the Bank, not later than November 15 of each year during theimplementation of the Project starting in 2022, a proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget for the next calendar year and provide theBank a reasonable opportunity to exchange views.

Without limitation to the provisions of Article V of the General Conditions, and except as the Bank shall otherwise agree, theBorrower shall maintain at all times during the implementation of the Project, a Working Group, within MSE, with composition,resources, terms of reference and functions acceptable to the Bank, including, inter alia, an environmental specialist, socialdevelopment specialist and a communication specialist.

title.narrative: MSE staff and school founders preparing cost-effective school network plans to scale up the WDS system

baseline.value: 0% of MSE staff and school founders preparing cost-effective school network plans to scale up the WDS system.

target.value: 75% of MSE staff and school founders preparing cost-effective school network plans to scale up the WDS system.

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the increased capacity of the MSE and school founders to implement complex reform, through successful preparation of documentation for investments in school infrastructure using cost-effective options to scale up the WDS system.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

actual.value: 0% of MSE staff and school founders preparing cost-effective school network plans to scale up the WDS system.

title.narrative: Share of students participating in the WDS reporting a boost in well-being, satisfaction and motivation in student surveys

comment.narrative:
Additionally, the NCVVO plans to conduct a series of surveys to measure socioeconomic status, well-being, student satisfaction and motivation to monitor the progress of the project.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: MSE staff participating in training on designing and implementing reforms

comment.narrative:
This indicator identifies the percentage of MSE staff participating in training on designing and implementing reforms to carry out the WDS reform as well as other educational initiatives.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Number of principals in low-performing WDS demonstration schools participating in peer mentoring program (cumulative)

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the number of principals from schools with below average academic performance that receive mentoring to implement the WDS system (Cumulative).
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Share of primary schools using new education database towards learning

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the percentage of elementary schools that will use new data on student learning to improve learning outcomes and teaching practices.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Percentage of WDS demonstration schools joining the peer-mentoring program

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the percentage of non-WDS schools joining a “peer-mentoring program” pairing schools with below average academic performance with top-performing schools.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Number of school founders benefiting from capacity building and training on network planning and costing

comment.narrative:
This indicator refers to the number of school founders benefiting from capacity building and training on network planning and costing. To this end, this indicator will measure the needs assessments of school founders, supporting school founders to conduct detailed analyses of their school networks and simulations; regional workshops; and preparation of local “school network plans for 2030.”
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 203).

title.narrative: Percentage of project beneficiaries reporting on beneficiary surveys satisfaction with engagement processes in the development and rollout of WDS in demonstration schools

comment.narrative:
This is a citizen engagement indicator to measure whether project beneficiaries (students, teachers, principals, parents, school founders, local government, etc.) feel their voices are heard, and therefore engagement processes effective, in the development and roll out of the WDS reform process in demonstration schools.
The Bank team is concerned about the continued lack of engagemnt with relevant stakeholders in the sector, such as teachers, school principals, and parents.

title.narrative: Teachers in WDS demonstration schools receiving training from learning counselors

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the number of teachers in WDS demonstration schools that will receive training and support from learning counselors who will be education experts from higher education and education institutes.

title.narrative: Students benefiting from the WDS pedagogical model

comment.narrative: This indicator describes the total number of students benefiting from the WDS pedagogical model.

title.narrative: Students benefiting from direct interventions to enhance learning

comment.narrative: The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Percentage of school founders receiving financing and guidance to prepare documentation for school infrastructure

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the percentage of school founders receiving financing and guidance to prepare documentation for school infrastructure.

title.narrative: Schools with improved physical environment according to WDS standards

comment.narrative:
This indicator indicates the number of demonstration schools that will be refurbished or rehabilitated according to WDS standards that will be designed through the project.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Number of WDS demonstration schools benefiting from infrastructure investments (Cumulative)

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the number of schools benefiting from infrastructure investments, including minor rehabilitation and refurbishment of learning environments, informal learning spaces, dining facilities, etc. that will allow an initial group of schools to adopt the WDS model.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Labor supply of mothers with children aged 6-14 benefiting from WDS (hours willing to work per day and hours of childcare per day)

baseline.value: Baseline measured at the beginning of school Year 1

target.value: 20% increase in average hours20% decrease in average hours of childcare

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the labor supply of mothers with children aged 6-14 benefitting from WDS. The indicator will take the values 0 to 8 and will be derived from a questionnaire asking, specifically, “How many hours per day would you be willing to work?” and “How many hours per day do you spend on childcare activities?"
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

actual.value: Baseline measured at the beginning of school Year 1

title.narrative: Working Group produces Annual Reports including feedback from school founders on the progress of the WDS implementation

baseline.value: Limited capacity of the Ministry to monitor implementation of the reform and use data for decision-making.

target.value: Working Group elaborates on Annual Reports including feedback from school founders on infrastructure and single-shift transition.

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the capacity of the MSE via an established Working Group within the Ministry to use data and monitor the implementation of complex reforms through the effective monitoring of the WDS implementation based on feedback from school founders and transparent reporting on the progress of reforms.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonsration schools (planned for September 2023).

actual.value: Limited capacity of the Ministry to monitor implementation of the reform and use data for decision-making.

comment.narrative:
The project will finance an impact evaluation comparing outcomes in the “demonstration schools” supported by this project, with an appropriately selected group of “control schools” to compare within and between-school differences of quality (all students) and equity (low-socioeconomic status students).
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Mechanism to foster peer-to-peer learning on learning spaces developed and implemented

comment.narrative:
This indicator measures the development and implementation of a mechanism to foster peer-to-peer learning on learning spaces.
The indicator will be tracked when WDS pilot is implemented in demonstration schools (planned for September 2023).

title.narrative: Standard designs developed for new modern and energy-efficient (green) schools

comment.narrative: Target achieved. This indicator measures the development of standard designs for new modern and energy-efficient (green) schools.

title.narrative: Pedagogical model documentation designed for WDS

comment.narrative: Target achieved. This indicator measures whether the pedagogical model required for the introduction of the WDS system has been designed.

title.narrative: Working Group with the capacity and responsibility to plan and implement reforms in the MSE established

comment.narrative: Target achieved. This indicator monitors the establishment and ongoing functioning of a strategic planning and reform implementation Working Group, which will play a key role from year 1 of implementation to building capacity of the MSE to plan and implement reforms.

title.narrative: Legislation on teacher and staff norms revised

comment.narrative: This indicator measures whether the legislation regarding staff and teacher norms to implement WDS reform have been revised.

title.narrative: Comprehensive communication and outreach strategy for the WDS developed

comment.narrative:
This indicator refers to the development of an effective nation-wide communication and outreach strategy led by the MSE to inform and engage with all stakeholders and the public about the comprehensive WDS reform.
The Bank team is concerned about the continued lack of appropriate engagement with relevant stakeholders in the sector, such as teachers, school principals, and parents.
